samples.question: How do I reset my password?
samples.ground_truth: Go to the login page, click 'Forgot Password', enter your email, check your inbox for the reset link, click the link and enter a new password with at least 8 characters including one number and one special character.

You'll be redirected to the login page to sign in with your new password. If you don't receive the email within 5 minutes, check your spam folder or contact support for assistance.

Setting up two-factor authentication: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable: 1) Go to Settings > Security. 2) Click 'Enable Two-Factor Authentication'. 3) Install an authenticator app like Google Authenticator, Authy, or Microsoft Authenticator on your phone. 4) Scan the QR code displayed on screen. 5) Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to verify setup. 6) Save your backup codes (store them somewhere safe — they are the only way to recover access if you lose your phone). Once enabled, you'll need both your password and a 6-digit code to log in.

Cancelling your subscription: To cancel your subscription: 1) Go to Settings > Billing. 2) Click 'Manage Subscription'. 3) Select 'Cancel Subscription'. 4) Choose a reason for cancellation (optional but helps us improve). 5) Confirm cancellation. Your subscription will remain active until the end of the current billing period. After cancellation, your account will be downgraded to the free tier. You'll lose access to premium features but your data will be retained for 90 days in case you reactivate. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days for annual plans canceled within 30 days of renewal.

How to merge duplicate accounts: If you have multiple accounts, you can merge them by contacting support. Before requesting a merge: 1) Make sure both accounts use the same email address or verify ownership of both accounts. 2) Decide which account will be the primary (retained) account — all data from the secondary account will be transferred to the primary. 3) Note that subscription plans cannot be combined; you'll need to choose one active subscription. 4) Data from the secondary account (projects, files, settings) will be transferred within 48 hours. samples.question: My payment was declined. What should I do?
samples.ground_truth: Check that your card details are up to date in Billing Settings. Common causes include expired card, insufficient funds, bank declined the transaction, incorrect CVV, or card not enabled for international transactions. You can retry or add a different payment method.

samples.question: How do I invite team members to my account?
samples.ground_truth: Go to Team Settings, click 'Invite Members', enter their email addresses, assign roles (Admin, Member, Viewer), and send the invitation. They will receive an email with a link to join your workspace.

samples.question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
samples.ground_truth: Go to Security Settings, click 'Enable 2FA', scan the QR code with an authenticator app like Google Authenticator or Authy, enter the verification code, and save your backup codes in a secure location.

samples.question: What should I do if I suspect my account has been compromised?
samples.ground_truth: Immediately change your password, enable two-factor authentication if not already enabled, review your active sessions and revoke any unrecognized ones, check your account activity log for suspicious actions, and contact support immediately.

samples.question: How do I export my data from the platform?
samples.ground_truth: Go to Account Settings, click 'Export Data', select the data you want to export (projects, documents, analytics), choose your preferred format (CSV, JSON, or PDF), and click Export. You will receive an email with a download link.

samples.question: What integrations are supported?
samples.ground_truth: We support integrations with Slack, GitHub, Jira, Trello, Google Drive, Dropbox, Zapier, and over 200 other services via our API. Enterprise plans include custom integrations and dedicated support.

samples.question: How do I create and manage API keys?
samples.ground_truth: Go to Developer Settings, click 'Create API Key', name your key, set permissions (read-only, read-write, or admin), and copy the generated key. Store it securely as it won't be shown again. You can revoke or rotate keys at any time.
